decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The details as shown on submitted drawing numbers 2005/16/2 and the fume extraction ducting installed on the premises are satisfactory to ensure that that neighbouring residents' living conditions would not be harmed by cooking odours from the premises and as a result of the equipment the appearance of the building would not be harmed, in line with policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Following approval for demolition of the existing (former) London Transport Sports Pavilion and erection of new sports and social clubhouse with tied-caretaker accommodation at first floor level, together with reinstatement of bowling green, 3 tennis courts and 1 netball court, new 44 space car park, looped foothpath access to open space with new access to Great West Road details submitted pursuant to Condition 18 (control of odours and fumes) of planning permission reference 00505/CH/P6 dated 15/03/2004.
